decisions.reason: The alleged race needs needs_changes/rejected to transition to approved. These states are terminal: reviewIntegrationRequest accepts only requested->decision or approved->rejected. A resubmittable parent cannot change to a non-resubmittable state. Existing terminal-state tests cover this invariant. Seller submission is intentionally independent of operator configuration.

The reviewer itself says history<=8 validates consistently and reproduction N/A; actual state transitions allow at most requested->approved->rejected (3 events). No off-by-one failure exists. Summary claims4 defects though only2 findings, so it is not a correctness certificate.
